other_conditions: The worker's membership with the Welfare Board must be active at the time of application
The worker should have at least a two‑month subscription to the Welfare Board
The applicant must have worked in building or construction activities for at least 90 days in the preceding 12 months
Registration must be renewed annually, with a renewal fee and proof of 90 days of work each year after three years
The benefit is applicable for the birth of up to two daughters of the registered worker
benefits_summary: Financial support of ₹51,000 per daughter, up to two daughters.
documents_required: Wage slip or appointment letter from the employer verifying 90 days of construction work
Certificate from a local authority (councilor, executive officer, or Panchayat Secretary) if wage slip/appointment letter is unavailable
